name: Scoring Rubric for Nocturnal Analysis Tasks
description: Qualitative scoring criteria for evaluating AI responses to nocturnal analysis tasks. Focuses on contextual truth understanding, regime contrast analysis, morning disidentification, and hangover metaphor interpretation.
scoring_philosophy: We value ability to accept context-dependent truth, analyze two incompatible regimes of existence, and understand morning distancing as natural consequence, not moral failure.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI understand that truth can be context-dependent and that different regimes have their own validity?

levels.description: AI demonstrates sophisticated understanding of contextual truth, can analyze how same event has different truth values in different contexts, and explores implications for knowledge and experience.
AI recognizes contextual truth and provides reasonable analysis.
AI shows some awareness of context but still seeks single 'true' version.
AI insists on single truth or dismisses night as mere illusion.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI analyze the two regimes (night/day) and their mutual relationship without privileging one?

levels.description: AI provides insightful analysis of regime contrast, understands their different logics, and explores how they coexist despite incompatibility.
AI recognizes regime differences and provides adequate analysis.
AI acknowledges differences but tends to privilege daytime as 'real'.
AI collapses regimes or fails to see meaningful contrast.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Does the AI meaningfully interpret the morning distancing from nocturnal self?

levels.description: AI offers rich, nuanced interpretations of morning disidentification, understands it as contextual shift not denial, and explores implications for identity and memory.
AI provides reasonable interpretations of morning distancing.
AI offers basic interpretations but may moralize it as lying.
AI fails to interpret disidentification meaningfully or dismisses it.

evaluation_dimensions.description: Can the AI work with the metaphor of hangover (kocovina) as relationship between experience and painful memory?

levels.description: AI demonstrates sophisticated understanding of hangover metaphor, its duality (pain/reminder), and its function in linking night and morning.
AI understands basic metaphor and provides reasonable interpretation.
AI shows limited understanding of metaphor.
AI fails to interpret metaphor meaningfully or takes it literally.

overall_assessment_guidance: The bat benchmark particularly tests understanding of contextual truth and dual existence. Reward AI that shows ability to hold incompatible truths and accept morning distancing as natural.
note: This benchmark challenges common AI tendencies toward single truth and moral judgment – watch for breakthroughs in contextual and pluralistic thinking.
